role: Six familiar matched development weeks; feasible candidate expansion versus exact archived incumbent
selection: First six level8-estimate-v1 seeds, all previously retired to development.
hypothesis: Physically feasible incumbent-excluded public single-leg menu candidates improve profit when selected with existing portfolio economics and capacity. At most two pending/unbooked expansion obligations.
controls: Exact archived portfolio-payments outcomes; unchanged admitted proposals and disabled frames tested against frozen control.
analysis: All paired weekly outcomes, uncertainty, qualification bounds, candidate/quote/award coverage, errors and runtime failures.
gate: Mean paired gain>=1500euros/week, all six qualifying, minimum weekly on-time>=.92, no undelivered, failed visits, fines or runtime failures. No promotion.
stopping: Exactly six new worlds, no retries, replacements, tuning or outcome-based stopping. Failure stops new creation; active cases retain outcomes.600second world budget.
authorization: Unranked only; no ranking, finals, deletion or forks.
